lines.beaver: 민수 씨, 이번 주말에 같이 운동할래요?
lines.beaver_en: Minsu, want to work out together this weekend?
lines.beaver_roman: Minsu ssi, ibeon jumare gachi undonghallaeyo?

lines.beaver_en: Then do you know how to play soccer?
lines.learner: 네, 할 줄 알아요. 공 차는 것을 잘해요.
lines.en: Yes, I do. I'm good at kicking the ball.
lines.roman: Ne, hal jul arayo. Gong chaneun geoseul jalhaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, do you have a soccer ball too?
lines.en: Yes, I have a soccer ball I bought last week.

lines.learner: 테니스는 칠 줄 몰라요. 한 번도 안 쳐 봤어요.
lines.en: I don't know how to play tennis. I've never tried it once.
lines.roman: Teniseuneun chil jul mollayo. Han beondo an chyeo bwasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: That's okay. I'll teach you at the tennis court.
lines.en: Thanks. Is the tennis court far away?

lines.beaver: 가까워요. 그런데 어제 축구 경기 봤어요?
lines.beaver_en: It's close. By the way, did you watch the soccer game yesterday?
lines.beaver_roman: Gakkawoyo. Geureonde eoje chukgu gyeonggi bwasseoyo?
lines.en: It was really fun. Our team won.

lines.beaver_en: Is there a player you like on that team?
lines.learner: 네, 어제 골을 넣은 선수를 좋아해요.
lines.en: Yes, I like the player who scored yesterday.
lines.roman: Ne, eoje goreul neoeun seonsureul joahaeyo.

lines.beaver: 저는 다음 달에 수영 대회에 나가요.
lines.beaver_en: I'm entering a swimming competition next month.
lines.beaver_roman: Jeoneun daeum dare suyeong daehoee nagayo.
lines.learner: 와, 멋있어요! 저는 수영할 줄 몰라요.
lines.en: Wow, that's cool! I don't know how to swim.
lines.roman: Wa, meosisseoyo! Jeoneun suyeonghal jul mollayo.

lines.beaver_en: Then do you know how to ski?
lines.en: Yes, I learned at the ski resort I went to last year.

lines.beaver_en: Great. Let's meet at the tennis court on Saturday!
lines.en: Okay, see you Saturday. I don't have a racket, though!
